svg.aria-label: A column of the five ways of visiting, lightest at the bottom: a plain request, a hidden browser, a disguised browser, a real browser, a patient visit. Svipall's hat climbs it: fares.example.net says Just a moment, Svipall climbs to a disguised browser and the page is read; members.example.com asks for a sign-in, Svipall stops at the first level and your AI is told a sign-in is needed.
svg.text: HOW IT GETS PAST A WALL
It climbs until it gets in
Lightest way first. A sign-in wall stops it, and your AI is told.

g.data-icon: stops: no climbing past a sign-in
